content: Planner, addressing dependency-resolver's note: since the 7 engine role-skills don't yet exist in W:\PMCR-O, this cycle's plan is to create them by porting from W:\PLUGINS\catalog\Platform\PMCR-O\skills\<role>\skills\<role>-role\SKILL.md into W:\PMCR-O\skills\<role>\SKILL.md (flat convention, matching the existing ceo/cfo/etc. layout -- no nested skills/ subfolder, no manifest.json, no per-skill .claude-plugin).

Step 1 (success: file exists, frontmatter name/description/metadata intact): write SKILL.md for checker, dependency-resolver, maker, planner, reflector -- these have no bundled references/commands/scripts in the source, straight content port with relative reference paths corrected.

Step 2 (success: SKILL.md plus references/, scripts/, commands/ all present, internal relative links resolve within the new flat layout): write orchestrator/SKILL.md and copy its 4 references (trail-schema, earned-constraints, hil-gating, ralph-loop-mechanics), 1 script (new_trail_id.py), and 4 commands (run-cycle, seal-trail, replay-trail, brief-session).

Step 3 (success: same criteria as step 2): write skill-creator/SKILL.md and copy its 2 references (agentskills-convention, marketplace-schema-notes) and 3 commands (create-skill, update-catalog, validate-skill).

Step 4 (success: marketplace.json remains valid JSON, 28 total plugin entries -- 21 existing + 7 new, each new entry has name/description/source/skills/category/displayName matching the pmcro-colony flat convention already used by the other 21): add 7 new plugin entries to W:\PMCR-O\.claude-plugin\marketplace.json.

Step 5 (success: this cycle only has the ONE marketplace.json twin that exists in W:\PMCR-O -- unlike W:\PLUGINS there is no .agents/plugins/marketplace.json twin here, confirmed by directory listing, so EC-011's twin-sync rule has only one file to satisfy in this repo): no second twin write needed; note the asymmetry explicitly in check/reflect rather than silently assuming a twin exists.

Step 6 (success: sealed disposition.json present): write check.jsonl, reflect.jsonl, and disposition.json. Per hil-gating.md ported in step 2, writing a live marketplace.json entry is a TYPE1 action -- this cycle seals needs-approval, not accept, regardless of clean checks.
